SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER,
       ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE,
       PATIENT_ID,
       OPERATION_TIME
  FROM ODS.M_INF_FXHIS_ACTIVITY

SELECT
  a.TEST_NO AS ID,
  NVL(a.PATIENT_ID,'-') AS PATIENT_ID,
  '6' AS ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE,
  '住院' AS ACTIVITY_TYPE_NAME,
  pmi.INP_NO || a.VISIT_ID AS SERIAL_NUMBER,
  pmi.NAME AS PATIENT_NAME,
  '01' AS ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE,
  '居民身份证' AS ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME,
  NVL(pmi.ID_NO,'-') AS ID_CARD,
  pv.DISCHARGE_WARD_CODE AS WARD_NAME,
  '' AS WARD_NO,
  TO_CHAR(pv.DISCHARGE_BED_NO) AS BED_NO,
  NVL(a.TEST_NO,'-') AS APPLICATION_FORM_NO,
  (SELECT MAX(dd.INFECT_DEPT_CODE) FROM HIS.INFECT_DEPT_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_DEPT_CODE=a.ORDERING_DEPT) AS APPLY_DEPT_CODE,
  (SELECT MAX(dd.INFECT_DEPT_NAME) FROM HIS.INFECT_DEPT_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_DEPT_CODE=a.ORDERING_DEPT) AS APPLY_DEPT_NAME,
  '370104000' AS APPLY_ORG_CODE,
  '山东省第二人民医院' AS APPLY_ORG_NAME,
  a.ORDERING_PROVIDER AS APPLY_PHYSICIAN_ID,
  NVL((SELECT dd.INFECT_SPECIMEN_CODE FROM HIS.LIS_SPECIMEN_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_SPECIMEN_NAME=a.SPECIMEN),'99') AS SPECIMEN_CATEGORY_CODE,
  NVL((SELECT dd.INFECT_SPECIMEN_NAME FROM HIS.LIS_SPECIMEN_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_SPECIMEN_NAME=a.SPECIMEN),'其他') AS SPECIMEN_CATEGORY_NAME,
  NVL(a.TEST_NO,'-') AS SPECIMEN_NO,
  TO_CHAR(a.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SPECIMEN_SAMPLING_DATE,
  TO_CHAR(a.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SPECIMEN_RECEIVING_DATE,
  (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST,'[0-9]') THEN a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST
        ELSE (SELECT MAX(y.EMP_NO) FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT y WHERE y.NAME=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST) END) AS EXAMINATION_PHYSICIAN_ID,
  TO_CHAR(a.EXECUTE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS EXAMINATION_DATE,
  NVL(a.RCPT_NO,(SELECT MAX(lr.Report_Id) FROM HIS.LAB_RESULT lr WHERE lr.TEST_NO=a.TEST_NO)) AS EXAMINATION_REPORT_NO,
  '' AS EXAMINATION_OBJECTIVE_DESC,
  '' AS EEXAMINATION_SUBJECTIVE_DESC,
  '' AS EXAMINATION_NOTES,
  TO_CHAR(a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS EXAMINATION_REPORT_DATE,
  (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST,'[0-9]') THEN a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST
        ELSE (SELECT MAX(y.EMP_NO) FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT y WHERE y.NAME=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST) END) AS EXAMINATION_REPORT_ID,
  '370104000' AS ORG_CODE,
  '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME,
  (SELECT MAX(dd.INFECT_DEPT_CODE) FROM HIS.INFECT_DEPT_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_DEPT_CODE=a.PERFORMED_BY) AS DEPT_CODE,
  (SELECT MAX(dd.INFECT_DEPT_NAME) FROM HIS.INFECT_DEPT_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_DEPT_CODE=a.PERFORMED_BY) AS DEPT_NAME,
  (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST,'[0-9]') THEN a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST
        ELSE (SELECT MAX(y.EMP_NO) FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT y WHERE y.NAME=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST) END) AS OPERATOR_ID,
  NVL(a.EXECUTE_DATE,a.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME) AS OPERATION_TIME
FROM HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER a
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = a.PATIENT_ID
JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT pv ON pv.PATIENT_ID = a.PATIENT_ID AND pv.VISIT_ID = a.VISIT_ID
WHERE a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND a.RESULT_STATUS = '4'
  AND a.VISIT_ID <> '0'
  AND a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ODS.M_INF_FXHIS_ACTIVITY act
              WHERE TRIM(act.PATIENT_ID) = TRIM(a.PATIENT_ID)
                AND TRIM(act.SERIAL_NUMBER) = TRIM(pmi.INP_NO || a.VISIT_ID))
UNION ALL
-- ---------- 门诊段（v1.3：经对照视图绑定唯一 CLINIC_NO；类型复用锚点值） ----------
SELECT
  a.TEST_NO AS ID,
  NVL(a.PATIENT_ID,'-') AS PATIENT_ID,
  act.ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE AS ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE,       -- 【v1.5 F01 修复】恢复引用锚点类型（急诊=2），不得固定'1'
  CASE act.ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE WHEN '2' THEN '急诊' ELSE '门诊' END AS ACTIVITY_TYPE_NAME,
  act.SERIAL_NUMBER AS SERIAL_NUMBER,                 -- =CLINIC_NO（与诊疗活动流水一致）
  NVL(pmi.NAME, cm.NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME,
  '01' AS ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE,
  '居民身份证' AS ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME,
  NVL(pmi.ID_NO,'-') AS ID_CARD,
  '' AS WARD_NAME,
  '' AS WARD_NO,
  '' AS BED_NO,
  NVL(a.TEST_NO,'-') AS APPLICATION_FORM_NO,
  (SELECT MAX(dd.INFECT_DEPT_CODE) FROM HIS.INFECT_DEPT_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_DEPT_CODE=a.ORDERING_DEPT) AS APPLY_DEPT_CODE,
  (SELECT MAX(dd.INFECT_DEPT_NAME) FROM HIS.INFECT_DEPT_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_DEPT_CODE=a.ORDERING_DEPT) AS APPLY_DEPT_NAME,
  '370104000' AS APPLY_ORG_CODE,
  '山东省第二人民医院' AS APPLY_ORG_NAME,
  a.ORDERING_PROVIDER AS APPLY_PHYSICIAN_ID,
  NVL((SELECT dd.INFECT_SPECIMEN_CODE FROM HIS.LIS_SPECIMEN_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_SPECIMEN_NAME=a.SPECIMEN),'99') AS SPECIMEN_CATEGORY_CODE,
  NVL((SELECT dd.INFECT_SPECIMEN_NAME FROM HIS.LIS_SPECIMEN_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_SPECIMEN_NAME=a.SPECIMEN),'其他') AS SPECIMEN_CATEGORY_NAME,
  NVL(a.TEST_NO,'-') AS SPECIMEN_NO,
  TO_CHAR(a.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SPECIMEN_SAMPLING_DATE,
  TO_CHAR(a.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SPECIMEN_RECEIVING_DATE,
  (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST,'[0-9]') THEN a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST
        ELSE (SELECT MAX(y.EMP_NO) FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT y WHERE y.NAME=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST) END) AS EXAMINATION_PHYSICIAN_ID,
  TO_CHAR(a.EXECUTE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS EXAMINATION_DATE,
  NVL(a.RCPT_NO,(SELECT MAX(lr.Report_Id) FROM HIS.LAB_RESULT lr WHERE lr.TEST_NO=a.TEST_NO)) AS EXAMINATION_REPORT_NO,
  '' AS EXAMINATION_OBJECTIVE_DESC,
  '' AS EEXAMINATION_SUBJECTIVE_DESC,
  '' AS EXAMINATION_NOTES,
  TO_CHAR(a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS EXAMINATION_REPORT_DATE,
  (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST,'[0-9]') THEN a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST
        ELSE (SELECT MAX(y.EMP_NO) FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT y WHERE y.NAME=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST) END) AS EXAMINATION_REPORT_ID,
  '370104000' AS ORG_CODE,
  '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME,
  (SELECT MAX(dd.INFECT_DEPT_CODE) FROM HIS.INFECT_DEPT_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_DEPT_CODE=a.PERFORMED_BY) AS DEPT_CODE,
  (SELECT MAX(dd.INFECT_DEPT_NAME) FROM HIS.INFECT_DEPT_DICT dd WHERE dd.HIS_DEPT_CODE=a.PERFORMED_BY) AS DEPT_NAME,
  (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST,'[0-9]') THEN a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST
        ELSE (SELECT MAX(y.EMP_NO) FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT y WHERE y.NAME=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST) END) AS OPERATOR_ID,
  NVL(a.EXECUTE_DATE,a.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME) AS OPERATION_TIME
FROM HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER a
JOIN HIS.CLINIC_MASTER cm ON a.PATIENT_ID=cm.PATIENT_ID
     AND TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')=TO_CHAR(a.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=a.PATIENT_ID
JOIN ODS.M_INF_FXHIS_ACTIVITY_V15 actv ON actv.TEST_NO = a.TEST_NO
     AND actv.CLINIC_NO = cm.CLINIC_NO
WHERE a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND a.RESULT_STATUS = '4'
  AND a.VISIT_ID = '0'
  AND a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-11-14'
WITH READ ONLY

SELECT
  a.TEST_NO||c.PRINT_ORDER AS ID,
  a.TEST_NO AS EX_LAB_ID,
  c.REPORT_ITEM_CODE AS ITEM_CODE,
  c.REPORT_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME,
  CASE WHEN c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' THEN 'P' WHEN c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' THEN 'N' ELSE c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR END AS SOURCE_EXAMINATION_RESULT_CODE,
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '阳性'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '阴性'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='H' THEN '偏高' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='L' THEN '偏低'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='Q' THEN '弱阳性' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='E' THEN '错误'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='M' THEN '正常' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='S' THEN '敏感'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='R' THEN '耐药' END AS SOURCE_EXAMINATION_RESULT_NAME,
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '01'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '02'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='Q' THEN '05' END AS EXAMINATION_RESULT_CODE,  -- 【v1.5 F03 修复】一般定量 H/L 不再转耐药(12/10)；仅阳/阴/弱阳性给标化码
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '阳性'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '阴性'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='Q' THEN '弱阳性' END AS EXAMINATION_RESULT_NAME,
  c.RESULT AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICATION,
  c.UNITS AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICA_UNIT,
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '0'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '0'
       ELSE SUBSTRB(REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.PRINT_CONTEXT,'^[^-]+'),1,20) END AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICA_LOWER,  -- 【v1.1】加20位截断（平台04"下限长度不超过20位"；CRBSB原版UPPER有截LOWER漏）
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '0'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '0'
       ELSE SUBSTRB(REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.PRINT_CONTEXT,'[^-]+$',1,1),1,20) END AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICA_UPPER,
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '0'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '0'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='H' THEN '2' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='L' THEN '1'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='Q' THEN '0' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='E' THEN '0'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='M' THEN '0' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='S' THEN '2'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='R' THEN '0' ELSE '0' END AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICATION_RI,
  (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST,'[0-9]') THEN a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST
        ELSE (SELECT MAX(y.EMP_NO) FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT y WHERE y.NAME=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST) END) AS OPERATOR_ID,
  NVL(a.EXECUTE_DATE,a.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME) AS OPERATION_TIME
FROM HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER a
JOIN HIS.LAB_TEST_ITEMS b ON a.TEST_NO=b.TEST_NO
JOIN HIS.LAB_RESULT c ON a.TEST_NO=c.TEST_NO AND b.ITEM_NO=c.ITEM_NO
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=a.PATIENT_ID
WHERE a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND a.RESULT_STATUS='4'
  AND c.REPORT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND a.VISIT_ID<>'0'
  AND a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME>=DATE'2026-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ODS.M_INF_FXHIS_ACTIVITY act
              WHERE TRIM(act.PATIENT_ID)=TRIM(a.PATIENT_ID)
                AND TRIM(act.SERIAL_NUMBER)=TRIM(pmi.INP_NO||a.VISIT_ID))

UNION ALL
-- ---------- 门诊段（2026-11-15 v1.2 新增：VISIT_ID='0'，ex_lab_id=TEST_NO=门诊检验主表，锚点=门诊诊疗 CLINIC_NO） ----------
SELECT
  a.TEST_NO||c.PRINT_ORDER AS ID,
  a.TEST_NO AS EX_LAB_ID,
  c.REPORT_ITEM_CODE AS ITEM_CODE,
  c.REPORT_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME,
  CASE WHEN c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' THEN 'P' WHEN c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' THEN 'N' ELSE c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR END AS SOURCE_EXAMINATION_RESULT_CODE,
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '阳性'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '阴性'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='H' THEN '偏高' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='L' THEN '偏低'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='Q' THEN '弱阳性' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='E' THEN '错误'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='M' THEN '正常' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='S' THEN '敏感'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='R' THEN '耐药' END AS SOURCE_EXAMINATION_RESULT_NAME,
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '01'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '02'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='Q' THEN '05' END AS EXAMINATION_RESULT_CODE,  -- 【v1.5 F03 修复】一般定量 H/L 不再转耐药(12/10)；仅阳/阴/弱阳性给标化码
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '阳性'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '阴性'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='Q' THEN '弱阳性' END AS EXAMINATION_RESULT_NAME,
  c.RESULT AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICATION,
  c.UNITS AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICA_UNIT,
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '0'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '0'
       ELSE SUBSTRB(REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.PRINT_CONTEXT,'[^-]+'),1,20) END AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICA_LOWER,
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '0'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '0'
       ELSE SUBSTRB(REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.PRINT_CONTEXT,'[^-]+$',1,1),1,20) END AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICA_UPPER,
  CASE WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阳性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='P') THEN '0'
       WHEN (c.RESULT LIKE '阴性%' OR c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='N') THEN '0'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='H' THEN '2' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='L' THEN '1'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='Q' THEN '0' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='E' THEN '0'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='M' THEN '0' WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='S' THEN '2'
       WHEN c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR='R' THEN '0' ELSE '0' END AS EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICATION_RI,
  (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST,'[0-9]') THEN a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST
        ELSE (SELECT MAX(y.EMP_NO) FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT y WHERE y.NAME=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST) END) AS OPERATOR_ID,
  NVL(a.EXECUTE_DATE,a.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME) AS OPERATION_TIME
FROM HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER a
JOIN HIS.LAB_TEST_ITEMS b ON a.TEST_NO=b.TEST_NO
JOIN HIS.LAB_RESULT c ON a.TEST_NO=c.TEST_NO AND b.ITEM_NO=c.ITEM_NO
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=a.PATIENT_ID
WHERE a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND a.RESULT_STATUS='4'
  AND c.REPORT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND a.VISIT_ID='0'
  AND a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME>=DATE'2026-11-14'  -- 【v1.3 2026-11-15】窗口与主表13号对齐=11-14起（库内曾为11-15致11-14下午单据漏明细：主表有明细无）
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ODS.M_INF_FXHIS_ACTIVITY act
              WHERE TRIM(act.PATIENT_ID)=TRIM(a.PATIENT_ID)
                AND TRIM(act.SERIAL_NUMBER)=(SELECT MAX(cm.CLINIC_NO) FROM HIS.CLINIC_MASTER cm
                                              WHERE cm.PATIENT_ID=a.PATIENT_ID
                                              AND TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')=TO_CHAR(a.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')))
WITH READ ONLY
